units.source_text: 没一会儿，矿车走出了约莫一二十米，这个时候，轨道的坡度突然变的很陡。

en.t: Before long, the mine cart had gone about ten or twenty meters, and then the slope of the track suddenly became very steep.

units.source_text: 无论三个人怎么使劲推，矿车也一动不动，而且很可能三个人会随着矿车一起滑落回到原处。

en.t: No matter how hard the three of them pushed, the mine cart would not move at all, and they were very likely to slide back down with it to where they had started.

units.source_text: 良平观察之后觉得可以了，于是就跟比自己小两岁的两个小孩发号施令。

en.t: After observing the situation, Ryohei decided it was all right, and began giving orders to the two children who were two years younger than he was.
